test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three of the following four are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) FHK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/395c31022f0fbaf31f8e11fa1af3e292088713f9957aa1dc137cc387ed6adff2.png] 

Option 2) LNP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10093e42286948b7bc0a4f01ada89764569e2206c022c812eab4c913adaa8fca.png] 

Option 3) QSV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/804952a3397ae309223932ff4ffd410949697bf1f5e4020a30655f75603f151e.png] 

Option 4) BDG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c49384fbfcae7ce0ca7bb50ee879fe83c97e1cd13411ae375f484a30ee0ef3d.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'LNP' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
